cases.condition: No strict dataset metadata manifest is available.
cases.minimum_next_action: Create the exact bounded dataset manifest with all four split roles.

cases.condition: A frame lacks source-run, acceptance, protocol, or license identity.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the first missing external lineage or license record and rerun the dataset audit.

cases.condition: A correlation group or source run spans splits, or an exact structure or label hash is duplicated.
cases.minimum_next_action: Rebuild group-disjoint source-run-disjoint splits and preserve the failed manifest.

cases.condition: Dataset metadata passes but referenced bytes remain unresolved.
cases.minimum_next_action: Freeze one provider-bound training plan against the exact dataset-audit hash.

cases.condition: Provider, version, or workflow mode is not an exact registered combination.
cases.minimum_next_action: Choose one exact provider-version-mode tuple from the provider matrix.

cases.condition: Seeds, loss, stopping, thresholds, frozen slice IDs, environment, config, or parent lineage is incomplete.
cases.minimum_next_action: Supply the first missing explicit plan field without using a provider default.

cases.condition: The frozen plan passed and the user requests training or pretrained inference.
cases.minimum_next_action: Obtain a trusted provider-adapter authorization bound to the exact plan and dataset.

cases.condition: Model artifact, training or official origin, parent record, units, convention, or license identity is missing.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the exact missing model-origin evidence without loading the artifact.

cases.condition: Test data influenced selection or was not held out until model and thresholds froze.
cases.minimum_next_action: Invalidate the independent-test claim and evaluate a genuinely untouched test set under a new frozen plan.

cases.condition: Any aggregate, species, configuration, or OOD metric exceeds a predeclared threshold, or evaluation roles alias.
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve the failed evaluation and revise data or model under a new plan.

cases.condition: Independent metrics pass but no bounded engine-specific deployment envelope exists.
cases.minimum_next_action: Define an exact bounded pilot envelope with adapter, monitor, stop, and rollback evidence.

cases.condition: The deployment adapter, monitor, stop action, rollback model, domain, units, pilot budget, or evidence-role separation fails.
cases.minimum_next_action: Repair the first bounded-envelope finding and rerun without launching a pilot.

cases.condition: All local deployment metadata gates pass, but the syntactic authorization reference is not authenticated.
cases.minimum_next_action: Have a trusted platform authenticate the authorization and resolve the exact bounded pilot action.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established uniquely from the exact available evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop and obtain the smallest exact evidence needed to select one earlier case unambiguously.
